nodes.label: SYNASE AI
nodes.tagline: Decision intelligence for product and DevOps engineering decisions
nodes.runtime: static dependency-free frontend over deterministic mock domain services

nodes.label: L0 Application shell
nodes.responsibility: Route resolution, one delegated event listener, hydration, route-scoped data loading, per-surface controllers.

nodes.label: L1 Domain view templates
nodes.responsibility: Pure HTML string builders grouped by domain. No transport, no persistence knowledge, no listeners.

nodes.label: L2 Domain service surface
nodes.responsibility: Per-domain named facades over the shared adapter. Returns { data, meta }.

nodes.label: L3 Adapter boundary
nodes.responsibility: mock implementation (shipped) and live implementation (fail-closed, unwired). Owns the fixture store.

nodes.label: L4 Transport
nodes.responsibility: fetchImpl, AbortController timeout, X-Request-ID, credentials: include, response decoding. Currently exercised only in tests.

nodes.label: L5 Backend /api/v1
nodes.responsibility: Unresolved. No server exists in this repository.

nodes.label: mockApi
nodes.role: Deterministic in-memory domain service. Owns the entire mock db fixture.

nodes.label: phase11Api
nodes.role: Integrations, operational activity, and immutable audit projections. Project scoped.
nodes.fixture: module-private providers, connections, runs, activity, audit + receipts Map

nodes.label: phase12Api
nodes.role: Workspace dashboard aggregate and integration readiness. Only service with a live adapter factory.

nodes.label: settingsApi
nodes.role: Settings control plane facade. Manages hierarchical configuration, credentials, connectors, policies, and automations.
nodes.fixture: db.settingsValues, db.apiKeys, db.settingsConnectors, db.settingsAutomations, db.agentPolicy, db.usageSummary

nodes.label: No external contact in mock mode
nodes.statement: The shipped adapter contacts no external provider, directory, server, or model.

nodes.label: No secret exposure
nodes.statement: No password, token, API key, cookie, authorization header, MFA secret, or secret-manager value reaches a display model or audit projection.

nodes.label: Recursively redacted, raw payloads omitted
nodes.statement: Sensitive metadata is redacted recursively; raw headers and request/response bodies are omitted, not truncated.

nodes.label: Approval is not execution
nodes.statement: An approval decision never implies downstream execution. downstreamExecuted and executed stay false.

nodes.label: Connect is not authorization
nodes.statement: Authorization, connection, health, and synchronization are four independent states.

nodes.label: Elapsed time is not progress
nodes.statement: Workflow progress comes only from authoritative events or snapshots, never from a timer.

nodes.label: Mock receipt is not a real action
nodes.statement: A submitted action yields a queued mock receipt with externalContacted:false and executed:false.

nodes.label: Mutations require an idempotency key
nodes.statement: Every mutation rejects with IDEMPOTENCY_REQUIRED when no key is supplied and replays the first receipt on retry.

nodes.label: No automatic retry of unsafe mutations
nodes.statement: Unsafe mutations are never silently retried by the transport.

nodes.label: No optimistic success on high-impact actions
nodes.statement: Approvals, publications, and syncs wait for the authoritative response.

nodes.label: Domain models are not persistence models
nodes.statement: Frontend domain contracts do not mirror PostgreSQL tables.

nodes.label: Activity is not audit
nodes.statement: Operational activity history is explicitly distinct from immutable security-grade audit.

nodes.label: Project scoping is enforced
nodes.statement: Every project-scoped read and mutation rejects cross-project identifiers as not found.

nodes.label: AI-proposed is not confirmed state
nodes.statement: Provenance distinguishes ai_suggested from confirmed project state.

nodes.label: Build success is not backend connectivity
nodes.statement: A green build or a passing suite never claims a live backend.

nodes.label: Live mode fails closed
nodes.statement: Missing base URL, non-HTTPS non-local base URL, or a malformed response aborts with a canonical error.

nodes.label: Audit is read-only
nodes.statement: No service exposes an audit mutation. The suite asserts phase11Api.updateAuditEvent is undefined.

nodes.label: UI output is escaped
nodes.statement: Every interpolated value passes through escapeHtml before entering innerHTML.

nodes.label: One router owns #main
nodes.statement: A single module resolves every route and a single delegated listener handles every action. No view attaches its own listener.

nodes.label: Domains do not import domains
nodes.statement: product, devops, mcp, context, outputs, integrations and work import only from shared/ and app/paths.js. shared/ imports nothing outside itself.

nodes.label: The work surface calls no model or tool
nodes.statement: Every assistant reply is a deterministic fixture. The receipt always reports externalContacted, downstreamExecuted and modelInvoked as false.

nodes.label: Chat artifacts are never confirmed state
nodes.statement: Artifacts carry provenance ai_suggested and render as a proposal, never as authoritative output.

nodes.label: One-time secret reveal
nodes.statement: Full secret values for API keys and credentials are shown exactly once in the creation receipt (secretShownOnce: true) and never persisted or queryable via list methods.

nodes.label: Strict scope precedence hierarchy
nodes.statement: Hierarchical configuration resolves through deterministic precedence (user > session > task > agent > project > workspace > system) with schema default fallback.

nodes.label: Authentication and session contracts
nodes.detail: login, registration, recovery, logout, renewal, and callback contracts are unresolved. The store ships with authenticated: true.

nodes.label: Complete DTO and error schemas
nodes.detail: Nullability, error envelopes, and full DTO shapes are not frozen.

nodes.label: Pagination and mutation idempotency policy
nodes.detail: page() hardcodes page 1 of 25. Server-side pagination and a documented idempotency window are undefined.

nodes.label: Workspace aggregate endpoints
nodes.detail: Dashboard, search, report, approval, integration, and activity aggregates do not exist. The dashboard ships a selected-project mock and labels it as such.

nodes.label: Active workspace/project context encoding
nodes.detail: How the server scopes requests to an active workspace or project is undefined.

nodes.label: Permissions beyond roles
nodes.detail: Roles exist in types.d.ts but capability and permission fields do not.

nodes.label: SSE envelope, auth, replay, retention
nodes.detail: Workflow streaming is a scripted mock. Event envelope, authentication, heartbeat, replay, and retention are undefined.

nodes.label: Signed upload flow
nodes.detail: initiateUpload returns a mock-upload: URL. Real signed initiation and completion are undefined.

nodes.label: Realtime transport outside workflow SSE
nodes.detail: No realtime channel exists for collaboration or presence.

nodes.label: Notification delivery
nodes.detail: No delivery channel, preference model, or retry policy exists.

nodes.label: API compatibility and deprecation policy
nodes.detail: No versioning or deprecation contract exists under /api/v1.

nodes.label: Security-grade audit retention
nodes.detail: Audit completeness, immutability guarantees, and retention are explicitly not claimed.

nodes.label: Two owners of /app/dashboard
nodes.detail: RESOLVED by the structural refactor. src/app/router.js declares the decision dashboard as the sole owner of /app/dashboard, and the superseded Phase 2 aggregate was removed. There is no MutationObserver.

nodes.label: ActivityItem exported from two type modules
nodes.detail: src/shared/types/types.d.ts and src/integrations/api/types.d.ts both export ActivityItem with different shapes. An unqualified import is ambiguous.

nodes.label: Three incompatible activity shapes
nodes.detail: shared/api/db.js uses actor:string; integrations/api/client.js uses actor/target objects; dashboard/api.js uses actor:string plus audit:false. Three fixtures, one concept.

nodes.label: liveApi is dead code
nodes.detail: src/shared/api/live.js exports liveApi whose request() always throws LIVE_API_NOT_CONFIGURED, and api is a hard alias of mockApi. Nothing can select the live adapter.

nodes.label: Duplicated project hydrate cascade
nodes.detail: RESOLVED by the structural refactor. The 7-stage cascade now lives once in hydrateProject() and is called from both hydrate() and the project switcher.

nodes.label: Asymmetric clone semantics
nodes.detail: shared/api/db.js page() returns live references into db, while the integrations and dashboard services use structuredClone and report/approval reads clone. List reads are mutable; single reads are snapshots.

nodes.label: CI workflow filename lags its purpose
nodes.detail: .github/workflows/phase11-validate.yml runs the full suite and writes phase12-validation.json. The filename misleads.

nodes.label: dev server requires a prior build
nodes.detail: scripts/serve.mjs serves dist/ only, so npm run dev after a fresh clone returns 404 until npm run build runs.

nodes.label: Single large orchestration module
nodes.detail: app/main.js is 771 lines because it owns hydration, route-scoped loading and every delegated action outside a per-surface controller. The Chat & Work controller was extracted to hold the line, but a second extraction will be needed if the surface keeps growing.

nodes.label: No lint, format, or typecheck script
nodes.detail: Type annotations exist (// @ts-check) but no tsconfig or checker runs in CI. Contract drift is only caught by tests.

nodes.label: Zero runtime dependencies
nodes.decision: No npm dependencies, no framework, no bundler. Ship hand-written ES modules.
nodes.consequence: No supply chain, no build step for the app itself, total control over the shipped bytes. Cost: no router, no reactive rendering, string templates everywhere.

nodes.label: Hash routing with a ?route= override
nodes.decision: Navigation uses location.hash so any static server works; ?route= takes precedence for deep links and QA.
nodes.consequence: Deployable as static files. Cost: no server-side routing, no real browser history entries (replaceState is used).

nodes.label: Per-phase modules instead of one growing app
nodes.decision: Each phase adds api, view, css, and types modules rather than extending app.js.
nodes.consequence: Phase boundaries stay legible and deletable. Cost: phase11.js and phase12.js take over #main from outside the router.

nodes.label: MutationObserver takeover for late modules
nodes.decision: phase11.js and phase12.js observe document.body and re-assert ownership of #main.
nodes.consequence: New phases integrate without editing the router. Cost: this is the mechanism behind rsk-01 and makes dashboard ownership implicit.

nodes.label: Mock as a service implementation, not a fixture leak
nodes.decision: Fixtures live behind domain methods returning { data, meta }, so mock and live share one boundary.
nodes.consequence: Swapping adapters does not touch views. Cost: 74 methods to keep in sync with types.d.ts.

nodes.label: Only Phase 12 exposes a live adapter factory
nodes.decision: createPhase12Service({ mode, baseUrl, fetchImpl, timeoutMs }) is the sole live seam, and it is not wired by default.
nodes.consequence: Live integration has exactly one reviewable entry point. Cost: Phases 0-11 have no live path at all.

nodes.label: Negative claims are asserted, not assumed
nodes.decision: The suite asserts externalContacted:false, executed:false, downstreamActionsExecuted:false and absence of secret literals rather than trusting them.
nodes.consequence: The safety story is regression-protected. Cost: 64 tests are load-bearing for product claims.

nodes.label: One router instead of three competing renderers
nodes.decision: src/app/router.js resolves every route and src/app/main.js owns one delegated listener. Plugin-private data-p11-*/data-p12-* attributes were normalised to data-route/data-action.
nodes.consequence: Route ownership is declared, not raced. Cost: an existing late module can no longer self-register without editing the router.

nodes.label: Domain layers with a shared leaf
nodes.decision: app/ -> domains -> shared/, with no domain importing another domain and shared/ importing nothing outside itself.
nodes.consequence: Boundaries are greppable and mechanically checkable. Cost: cross-domain needs must be lifted into shared/ rather than reached sideways.

nodes.label: One fixture store, partitioned API surface
nodes.decision: The mock db stays in shared/api/db.js because its tables are cross-referenced; each domain exposes a narrow facade in <domain>/api/index.js instead.
nodes.consequence: There is still exactly one implementation of every method, and the boundary is explicit without rewriting the most-executed file. Cost: the facades add one indirection.

nodes.label: Chat renders outside the console shell
nodes.decision: /app/chat returns its markup without shell(), and the router checks it before the loading branch. Work is the existing dashboard inside the shell.
nodes.consequence: Signing in opens only the chat canvas, and the console chrome can never flash first. Cost: the chat needs its own header and cannot reuse shell-level controls.

nodes.label: Three composer controls, not one cascading menu
nodes.decision: The + chip is Agent Mode and nothing else; the layer and effort chips each open their own popover. The artifact panel is collapsible and keeps its selection across a collapse.
nodes.consequence: A session already scoped to Product or DevOps cannot re-pick its layer from Agent Mode, and the panels cannot grow into one list. Cost: three popovers instead of one, each with its own anchor.

nodes.label: Settings renders outside console chrome
nodes.decision: /app/settings renders as a dedicated full-page control plane without the console shell sidebar or nested bounding boxes. Features clean white canvas and top navigation back to console.
nodes.consequence: No boxed-inside-box clustering. Clear operational focus for system configuration. Cost: Settings owns its own header and sidebar.

nodes.label: Deterministic scope precedence resolver
nodes.decision: Settings values are resolved via pure hierarchical order (user > session > task > agent > project > workspace > system).
nodes.consequence: Predictable override behavior across all 16 domains. Prevents configuration drift. Cost: Requires explicit scope metadata on all definition entries.

nodes.capability: summary, findings, recommendations, dependencies, tests, deployments

nodes.label: Phase 9
nodes.name: Context and Knowledge

nodes.label: Phase 12
nodes.name: Dashboard, integration readiness, and QA
nodes.capability: workspace dashboard, readiness checks, live adapter seam

nodes.label: Phase 13
nodes.name: Structural refactor to domain modules
nodes.capability: app/ -> domains -> shared/ layering, one router, theme tokens, dark mode

nodes.label: Phase 14
nodes.name: Chat and Work surfaces
nodes.capability: Standalone chat page outside the console shell; surface toggle to Work; three composer controls where the + chip is Agent Mode only and layer/effort open from their own chips; collapsible artifact panel

nodes.label: Phase 15
nodes.name: Settings Control Plane
nodes.capability: 16-domain full-page hierarchical settings control plane outside console shell, scope precedence resolution, API key one-time reveals, connectors, agent policies, automations, and clean white theme

nodes.label: Phase 16
nodes.name: Contract registry and freeze
nodes.rationale: Publish the authoritative DTO, error, pagination, and versioning contracts before any adapter work. Turns the twelve known gaps into tracked, testable documents.

nodes.label: Phase 17
nodes.name: Auth and session lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Replace the hardcoded authenticated flag with a real session contract, capability fields beyond roles, and explicit active-context encoding.

nodes.label: Phase 18
nodes.name: Backend aggregate endpoints
nodes.rationale: Give the dashboard real workspace-scoped aggregates so cross-domain pages stop needing browser-side relational reconstruction.

nodes.label: Phase 19
nodes.name: Authoritative workflow streaming
nodes.rationale: Replace db.workflowScripts with a real SSE channel that carries authoritative event and snapshot state with replay and heartbeat.

nodes.label: Phase 20
nodes.name: Signed input pipeline
nodes.rationale: Replace the mock-upload: URL with signed initiation and completion, keeping security scan and extraction as distinct states.
deliverables: scan and extraction status remain independent

nodes.label: Phase 21
nodes.name: Governed audit and notifications
nodes.rationale: Move audit from a read-only fixture to a governed append-only store with a stated retention policy, and add a delivery channel.
deliverables: inv-12 keeps activity separate from audit
